who_html:
BookingKoala's home page lists the industries it's set up for. Cleaning leads the list: home cleaning, office cleaning, post-construction, carpet cleaning, window cleaning, pool cleaning and gutter cleaning, plus lawn care, car wash, moving, pet grooming, dog walking, salons and other appointment businesses. Its pricing page defines a provider as "someone that performs the service, which can be a maid, a dog walker, a barber, tutors."

It's built around customers booking online. Every plan includes a website builder with themes, your own domain, customizable booking forms with real-time availability, and customer, provider and admin dashboards. Features we confirmed on its features page: pricing by quantity, hours or packages; multi-location pricing and sales tax by zip code; recurring appointments; an accept/decline option so providers confirm jobs; expedited same-day fees; invoicing; email and text campaigns with A/B testing; and a hiring module with applicant forms, auto-graded quizzes and signed contracts. Growing ($57/mo) adds advanced reports, referrals and ratings, gift cards, GPS clock in/out and SMS notifications. Premium ($197/mo) adds Campaigns (5,000 contacts), multi-step forms, daily discounts, multilingual and funnels.
compare_html:
BookingKoala centers on online booking and your website. The other tools we track center on quoting, dispatch and field work. Here's how the published facts compare (all checked 2026-10-26):

{{table:bookingkoala,jobber,housecall-pro,kickserv}}
  • Jobber starts at $29/mo billed annually ($49/mo monthly) for 1 user and lists QuickBooks Online and Xero sync from Connect. BookingKoala Starter is $27/mo and counts up to 5 providers, but it doesn't list QuickBooks.
  • Housecall Pro includes online booking from Basic ($59/mo annually, 1 user) and route optimization on MAX. See Housecall Pro pricing.
  • Kickserv includes 5 users on Start ($60/mo annually, $75/mo monthly) and QuickBooks Online on every plan.
  • ResponsiBid is a quoting tool, not a CRM, and it's popular with window and exterior cleaners who want instant online quotes.

Window cleaner? See best window cleaning software and Jobber alternatives.
